text:
Nina: Quick non-work poll — what's the ONE snack in the office kitchen you'd put a 'do not touch' sign on? bonus: where'd you get it?
AJ: My emergency jar of miso cookies. Bought from a weird popup market. Labelled it "DO NOT EAT (AJ)" but it still disappears. :eyes:
Marc: My artisanal hot sauce stash. Not technically a snack but it's my soul. Source: tiny online shop. If you touch it I will cry. :cry:
Sophia: A half-eaten tub of mom's lemon curd someone left. It's cursed. Found it in the back fridge. Please don't. :nauseated_face:
Kelly: A sealed pack of vintage gummy bears from a trip to Berlin. Collector's item (yes I'm serious). I put a Post-it that says `museum piece`. :laughing:
AJ: Also — sometimes people label things with ☠️ which is very helpful.
Nina: Love the museum piece idea. Might start a locked snack cabinet. :lock:
lunchbot: Kitchen reminder: please label personal food with name and date. Unlabelled items older than 72h will be composted.
Marc: Can we have a sticker sheet: 
``
[ DO NOT EAT ]
[ TAKE AT YOUR OWN RISK ]
[ MUSEUM PIECE ]
```
Sophia: If someone steals my lemon curd I will put spicy hot sauce in all their lunches. (joking? maybe not) :smiling_imp:
Kelly: Winner of the thread: museum piece gummy bears. I nominate Kelly's stash for official office trophy. :trophy:
